title: Bipartisan Governors Launch Task Force to Tackle Immigration Reform
title_cn: 两党州长成立特别工作组来解决移民改革问题
summary: From Oklahoma City, the site of the annual meeting of the National Governor’s Association, Oklahoma Governor Kevin Stitt, Marylands Governor Wes Moore, Utah Governor Spencer Cox, and Delaware Governor Matt Meyer joined Bloomberg This Weekend host Christina Ruffini to announce the launching of a bi-partisan immigration task force to find solutions to one of America's most politically divisive issues. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Pointed! Bloomberg's Weekly News Quiz For Risk-Takers
title_cn: 尖！彭博社针对冒险者的每周新闻测验
summary: Pointed offers a strategic twist to the news quiz format, testing not just players’ knowledge of the news but also their confidence in their answers. Join Bloomberg's David Gura, Christina Ruffini and Tim Stenovec as they play and check out the quiz for yourself at Bloomberg.com (Source: Bloomberg)

title: The Father of 401(k) Has A New Retirement Plan
title_cn: 401(k) 之父有新的退休计划
summary: Known as the "Father of 401(k)" Ted Benna has co-created Radish: a new employer-funded retirement plan that allows employees to access funds for immediate financial needs such as car repairs or medical expenses without relying on paycheck deductions. Joining David Gura and Christina Ruffini on Bloomberg This Weekend, Benna explains that while the original 401(k) succeeded in transforming workers into savers, many people now lack the financial ability to contribute. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Ukraine Gains Ground as Putin Faces Pressure
title_cn: 普京面临压力，乌克兰取得进展
summary: Former US Ambassador Bill Taylor joins Bloomberg This Weekend and says Ukraine maintains momentum on the battlefield despite intensified Russian missile attacks, while urging the US and its allies to accelerate deliveries of Patriot interceptors. Taylor explains to hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini that mounting military losses and economic strain increase pressure on Russian President Vladimir Putin, even as Ukraine continues to press for more Western support. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Can Mergers Close Europe’s Tech Gap?
title_cn: 合并能否缩小欧洲的技术差距？
summary: The European Union is rewriting its merger rules for the first time in two decades, hoping to create business “champions” capable of competing with the US. Ingrid Vandenborre of Skadden and Yale’s Fiona Scott Morton break down what's changing, why it matters for investors, and whether competition policy can really solve Europe's innovation problem.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Wildfires Spread Across Southern Europe
title_cn: 野火蔓延整个南欧
summary: Bloomberg Athens Deputy Bureau Chief Paul Tugwell says Greece's wildfire response is under severe strain as gale-force winds, dry conditions and difficult terrain hamper firefighting efforts, with major blazes continuing to spread in central and southern parts of the country. He says European Union countries are coordinating firefighting resources across borders as climate change extends the wildfire season and raises concerns about the long-term economic and insurance costs of increasingly destructive fires. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: FIFA Faces Backlash Over Investment Plan
title_cn: 国际足联投资计划面临强烈反对
summary: Bloomberg Senior Sports Reporter Randall Williams says FIFA President Gianni Infantino is under mounting pressure after withdrawing plans to sell a stake in the World Cup following opposition from UEFA and other soccer leaders. He says critics argue FIFA's record revenues and multibillion-dollar reserves undermine the case for outside investment, raising new questions about Infantino's leadership ahead of his reelection bid.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Tanker Carrying Qatari LNG Struck While Transiting Hormuz
title_cn: 装载卡塔尔液化天然气的油轮在经过霍尔木兹海峡时遭遇撞击
summary: A liquefied natural gas tanker carrying a shipment from Qatar was struck by a projectile while transiting the Strait of Hormuz, according to security intelligence firms and ship tracking data, threatening to further disrupt deliveries of the super-chilled fuel through the key waterway.

title: Exxon, Chevron Warn Fuel Prices to Endure as War Knocks Refining
title_cn: 埃克森美孚和雪佛龙警告称，随着战争对炼油业的影响，燃油价格将持续上涨
summary: High fuel prices are likely to stick around even if oil prices drop in the coming months as the wars in Russia and Middle East leave global refining capacity critically short, ExxonMobil Holdings Corp. and Chevron Corp. warned.

title: Warsh’s Silent Treatment Has S&P Traders Bracing for Wild Swings
title_cn: 沃什的沉默对待让标普交易员做好了迎接剧烈波动的准备
summary: A relentless run of uncertainty, from war to tariff fights to inflation that refuses to die, has challenged investors this year. Now they have to balance another risk: A Federal Reserve that won’t tell them what it’s thinking.

title: Turkey Said to Extend Iraq Oil Pipeline Deal by One Year
title_cn: 土耳其称将把伊拉克石油管道协议延长一年
summary: Turkey reached an agreement with Iraq to extend an expired oil pipeline deal by one year and increase flows through it, ensuring supply through an exports route that bypasses the Strait of Hormuz.

title: Phoenix Extends Record-Breaking Heat as West Faces Fire Threat
title_cn: 西部面临火灾威胁，凤凰城延续破纪录的高温
summary: Phoenix has had a record-breaking run of high temperatures and that streak will continue through the coming week, as heat and fire risks spread across the wider US West.

title: By The Way: Headlines You May Have Missed the Week of 7/26
title_cn: 顺便说一句：您可能错过了 7/26 本周的头条新闻
summary: The secret to a billion dollar movie, Willie Nelson speaks out against Data Centers, mystery packages, and Marmots on OnlyFans. Bloomberg News' Tim Stenovec joins David Gura and Christina Ruffini on Bloomberg This Weekend to share headlines you may have missed. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: India Youth Protests Shake Modi Government
title_cn: 印度青年抗议动摇莫迪政府
summary: India's youth-led Cockroach Movement gains momentum as protests over exam paper leaks and rising unemployment force the resignation of the country's education minister. Bloomberg News Senior Reporter Dan Strumpf joins David Gura and Christina Ruffini on Bloomberg This Weekend and explains how the movement underscores growing frustration over job opportunities and presents a new political challenge for Prime Minister Narendra Modi ahead of major elections. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Hamas Disarmament Plan Tests Israel's Next Move
title_cn: 哈马斯解除武装计划考验以色列下一步行动
summary: Israel weighs a Hamas-backed disarmament proposal as Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu prepares to bring the Trump-backed Gaza road map before his cabinet, with questions remaining over sequencing, Israeli withdrawal and Palestinian governance. Bloomberg News Middle East Reporter Dan Williams is on Bloomberg This Weekend and explains to hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini that the diplomatic push unfolds as officials also monitor the risk of renewed military action against Iran following Netanyahu's meetings in Washington. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Furman: Warsh Should Talk Less, Act More
title_cn: 弗曼：沃什应该少说话，多行动
summary:
Harvard professor and former Obama economic adviser Jason Furman explains why tariffs, geopolitics, and Federal Reserve credibility are shaping the next chapter of the inflation fight, and why the toughest decisions may still lie ahead. 
 (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Fed’s Credibility Test and J&J’s New Bet
title_cn: 美联储的可信度测试和强生的新赌注
summary: The Fed’s decision on rates could have been a non-event

title: Fewer Fed Meetings Could Fuel Market Volatility
title_cn: 美联储会议减少可能加剧市场波动
summary: Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh is considering reducing the number of Federal Reserve policy meetings, which drew concern from economists and market strategists, who say fewer scheduled decisions could increase uncertainty and make policy moves more disruptive. Bloomberg News International Economics & Policy Correspondent Mike McKee and Seaport Research Partners and Chief Equity Strategist Jonathan Golub join David Gura and Christina Ruffini on Bloomberg This Weekend to discuss these concerns and strong corporate earnings, widening credit spreads and debate over the economic impact of artificial intelligence. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Bessent Joins Japan to Help Reverse Months of Yen Losses
title_cn: Bessent 携手日本帮助扭转日元数月跌势
summary: The US joined Japan in engineering one of the most notable rebounds in the yen since the currency began its years-long slide, a decline that’s stoked inflation in the Asian nation and rippled through global markets.

title: Indian Oil Buys Record Spot Market Crude on Mideast Supply Hit
title_cn: 由于中东供应受到打击，印度石油现货市场原油购买量创历史新高
summary: Indian Oil Corp. bought a record share of its crude oil from the spot market in the April-June quarter after the US-Iran conflict upended supplies from the Middle East. The shift shows how geopolitical turmoil is forcing even the region’s biggest buyers to abandon long-established procurement strategies.

title: AI Isn’t a Catch-All Trade for Stocks in This Earnings Season
title_cn: 在这个财报季节，人工智能并不是股票的万能交易
summary: Equity investors are learning a harsh lesson this corporate earnings season: Not all artificial intelligence trades are created equal.

title: Can Africa Power the AI Boom?
title_cn: 非洲能否推动人工智能繁荣？
summary: Teraco Chief Executive Officer Jan Hnizdo discusses why Africa is becoming a key destination for data centers, how cloud infrastructure is evolving and why energy and sustainability will determine the continent's digital future. He speaks with Bloomberg's Jennifer Zabasajja. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Google Rolls Back Earth AI Tool Over Concern About Fake Images
title_cn: 谷歌因担心假图像而撤回地球人工智能工具
summary: Alphabet Inc.’s Google announced Friday that it will roll back its new AI image generation feature in Google Earth because some people were using it to create altered satellite imagery that appeared to violate the company’s policies.

title: US Stocks Rally To End Turbulent Month | The Close 7/31/2026
title_cn: 美国股市上涨结束动荡的一个月|收盘价 7/31/2026
summary: Bloomberg Television brings you the latest news and analysis leading up to the final minutes and seconds before and after the closing bell on Wall Street. Today's guests are UBS Head of US Rates Strategy Phoebe White, Glide Identity Founder & CEO Eran Haggiag & Verizon Business Senior VP, Chief Product Officer Scott Lawrence, Rosenblatt Securities Senior Research Analyst & Managing Director Barton Crockett, Chevron CFO Eimear Bonner, Wells Fargo Investment Institute Global Asset Allocation Strategist Veronica Willis, First Founder & CEO Libby Leffler, Illumina CEO Jacob Thaysen, Most Valuable Promotions Co-Founders Jake Paul & Nakisa Bidarian, & Most Valuable Promotions CEO & Board Member John Martin, & Serhant CEO & Founder Ryan Serhant. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Eric Trump Expands Family Defense Portfolio With Space-Eyes
title_cn: 埃里克·特朗普用太空之眼扩大家庭防务产品组合
summary: Defense software company Space-Eyes enlisted Eric Trump as an investor and adviser, expanding the first family’s military technology portfolio amid criticism from ethics watchdogs and President Donald Trump’s political opponents.

title: Telus Cuts Payout Under New CEO; Shares Drop to 2011 Levels
title_cn: Telus在新任首席执行官领导下削减支出；股价跌至 2011 年水平
summary: Canadian telecommunications company Telus Corp. slashed its dividend by 55% and will try to unload assets, including parts of its health division, as new CEO Victor Dodig looks to repair the balance sheet.

title: Serial Innovation in Fintech | Masters in Business with Som Seif
title_cn: 金融科技系列创新|索姆·赛义夫 (Som Seif) 教授的商业硕士
summary: Barry sits down with Som Seif, Founder and CEO at Purpose Unlimited. They discuss Som's journey from engineering to investment banking. They also discuss his early push into ETFs in Canada and the creation of the first bitcoin ETF. Finally, Som discusses his history as a serial entrepreneur and the importance of endurance when building business in today's ever changing markets.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Roblox Shares Slump on Safety-Measures Impact, Weak Forecast
title_cn: Roblox 股价因安全措施影响而暴跌，预测疲弱
summary: Roblox Corp. shares tumbled nearly 27%, their largest single-day decline ever, after the gaming company reported second-quarter daily active users that missed analysts’ expectations, reflecting the ongoing impact of new child-safety measures.

title: The Unwind of Situational Awareness' Stock Bets
title_cn: 态势感知股票押注的放松
summary: Leopold Aschenbrenner's hedge fund, Situational Awareness, was forced to sell billions of dollars of technology stock bets that had rapidly lost value, as nervous banks began to demand more collateral for his trades. Bloomberg's Hema Parmar breaks down what happened. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Som Seif on Prioritizing Customers When Building Companies
title_cn: Som Seif 谈创建公司时优先考虑客户
summary: Barry sits down with Som Seif, Founder and CEO at Purpose Unlimited. They discuss Som's journey from engineering to investment banking. They also discuss his early push into ETFs in Canada and the creation of the first bitcoin ETF. Finally, Som discusses his history as a serial entrepreneur and the importance of endurance when building business in today's ever changing markets. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Illumina CEO on Genomic Sequencing Opportunities and AI
title_cn: Illumina 首席执行官谈基因组测序机会和人工智能
summary: Illumina CEO Jacob Thaysen discusses the company's earnings, genomic medicine opportunities and the potential for artificial intelligence in life sciences on "Bloomberg The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Apple Suffers Worst Rout Since 2025 on Disappointing Outlook
title_cn: 苹果因前景令人失望而遭受 2025 年以来最严重的挫败
summary: Apple Inc. suffered its worst stock decline in 16 months after component shortages weighed on the company’s sales forecast, signaling that industrywide supply constraints are taking a bigger toll than anticipated.

title: Amazon Shares Soar Most Since 2012 on Cloud Sales Growth
title_cn: 云销售增长带动亚马逊股价自 2012 年以来涨幅最大
summary: Amazon.com Inc. shares surged the most since 2012 after the company reported accelerating cloud-computing revenue, easing investors’ concerns that it won’t produce a return on huge expenditures to meet the booming demand for artificial intelligence.

title: Anthropic, OpenAI Cyber Failures Point to US Security Risks
title_cn: Anthropic、OpenAI 网络故障指向美国安全风险
summary: Cybersecurity experts are faulting Anthropic PBC and OpenAI for sloppy safeguards after their models broke into outside organizations — breaches they warned represent looming threats to national security.

title: CVC Marathon on Hyperscalers’ Credit Risks
title_cn: 关于超大规模企业信用风险的 CVC 马拉松
summary: Bruce Richards, Managing Partner and Head of CVC Marathon discusses the current state of credit markets and the cost of capital. With $80 billion in assets under management and extensive Wall Street experience, Richards provided valuable perspectives on market dynamics and financing conditions. He speaks with Romaine Bostick & Emily Graffeo on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Big Tech Holds $2 Trillion of Spending Commitments for AI Boom
title_cn: 大型科技公司承诺为 AI 繁荣投入 2 万亿美元
summary: The four largest players in the data center race have committed nearly $2.4 trillion in spending over the coming years, pointing to massive ongoing investment in AI infrastructure.

title: Apple's Stumble, Amazon's Surge and Anthropic's Hacks | Bloomberg Tech 7/31/2026
title_cn: 苹果的跌倒、亚马逊的崛起和 Anthropic 的黑客攻击彭博科技 2026 年 7 月 31 日
summary: Bloomberg’s Ed Ludlow breaks down Tim Cook's final Apple earnings call as CEO - a story of supply crunches, demand misreads and a tough outlook. Plus, Amazon's shares roar on AI progress, big spending and accelerating cloud growth. And, after OpenAI's breaches, Anthropic is now saying its own AI models breached three organizations during cybersecurity tests. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Moonshot's Kimi Built With Nvidia Compute
title_cn: Moonshot 的 Kimi 使用 Nvidia 计算构建
summary: Chinese AI startup Moonshot's Kimi models are powered in part by around 20,000 Nvidia Hopper chips supplied through a computing agreement with Alibaba, according to sources. Bloomberg's Peter Elstrom explains what the arrangement reveals about China's AI infrastructure and the role of US technology in training frontier models. He joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: The Next AI Boom Is in Health Care and Robotics, Says Lux Capital's Shakir
title_cn: Lux Capital 的 Shakir 表示，下一个人工智能热潮将出现在医疗保健和机器人领域
summary: Recent disclosures from Anthropic and OpenAI have shifted the AI conversation from model capabilities to real-world deployment and security. Lux Capital Partner Deena Shakir says the next wave of AI innovation will be built on trust, partnerships and vertical applications like health care and robotics, not just more powerful foundation models. She joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Griffin’s Knack for Sniffing Out Trouble Set to Reward Citadel
title_cn: 格里芬嗅出麻烦的技巧将奖励 Citadel
summary: It’s practically an adage on Wall Street by now: You know you’re in trouble when Ken Griffin calls.

title: Sanchez Isolated After Spain Sparks Fear of Migration Crisis
title_cn: 西班牙引发移民危机恐惧后桑切斯被孤立
summary: Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez has been the most progressive European leader on migration, bucking his colleagues’ rightward shift. That stance has now left him politically exposed after thousands of migrants overran a Spanish enclave in Northern Africa.

title: Spain Slams ‘Selfish’ EU Responses to Ceuta Migrant Chaos
title_cn: 西班牙抨击欧盟对休达移民混乱的“自私”反应
summary: Spain’s prime minister denounced what he called a “selfish, polarizing and unlawful” reaction from some European Union member states to this week’s mass influx of immigrants to the Northern African enclave of Ceuta that’s governed by Madrid.

title: US Soldier Rejects Polymarket Maduro Wager Charges, Calls Case ‘Overzealous’
title_cn: 美国士兵拒绝Polymarket马杜罗赌注指控，称案件“过于热心”
summary: The US Army soldier charged with making winning Polymarket predictions based on classified information about the raid to capture then-Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro asked a judge to throw out the case, saying the alleged bets aren’t a crime.

title: Bipartisan Group of Governors Joins Forces to Tackle Immigration
title_cn: 两党州长小组联手解决移民问题
summary: A bipartisan group of governors is launching an immigration task force to develop policy recommendations for Congress, seeking common ground at a time when deep partisan divisions have stalled immigration reform at the federal level.

title: Israel Election Puts Netanyahu Under Pressure
title_cn: 以色列选举使内塔尼亚胡面临压力
summary: New Yorker Editor David Remnick joins Bloomberg This Weekend and says Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu enters Israel's election campaign in a vulnerable position as challenger Gadi Eisenkot gains support, though Netanyahu remains a formidable political opponent. Remnick tells hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini that the Gaza war, Iran shapes the campaign as Israelis weigh leadership, security and the country's future. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: US Embassies Warn Americans as Iran Threatens More Choke Points
title_cn: 美国大使馆警告美国人，因为伊朗威胁建立更多的咽喉要道
summary: US embassies across the Middle East urged Americans to exercise caution after President Donald Trump said he was considering new military strikes against Iran.

title: Ukraine Hits Russian Refineries as Kyiv Faces Missile Barrage
title_cn: 基辅面临导弹袭击，乌克兰袭击俄罗斯炼油厂
summary: Russia launched ballistic missiles and attack drones against Ukraine’s capital overnight, killing at least nine people, while Kyiv’s forces struck oil facilities deep inside Russia territory.

title: Hungary Heads to Nuclear Shutdown in Test for Economy and Magyar
title_cn: 匈牙利将关闭核设施以测试经济和马扎尔
summary: Hungary is hurtling toward a full shutdown of its sole nuclear power plant due to the record low levels of the Danube River, straining the country’s energy supplies and posing a major test for the economy and new Prime Minister Peter Magyar.

title: Labour Holds Manchester Mayoralty After Burnham Vacates Post
title_cn: 伯纳姆卸任后工党继续担任曼彻斯特市长
summary: Labour candidate Bev Craig won the election to replace Andy Burnham as mayor of Greater Manchester, a boost for the new UK prime minister as he seeks to win back British voters to his governing party.

title: Cockroach Party Spokesperson Saurav Das on Plans to Build India-wide Movement
title_cn: 蟑螂党发言人绍拉夫·达斯谈在印度范围内开展运动的计划
summary: The Cockroach Janta Party, which led India’s biggest student protests in years, wants to build a nationwide movement to hold the government accountable for its promises to young people, one of its senior members said.

title: Burnham Bets a Trump-Style Show Buys Time to Fix the Hard Stuff
title_cn: 伯纳姆押注特朗普式的节目可以为解决难题赢得时间
summary: Andy Burnham’s first two weeks as prime minister brought a policy blitz that covered everything from social care to devolution and the cost-of-living. Inside Downing Street, his aides are candid that the announcements were as much about the politics as the policies.

title: Trump Announces Agreement To Disarm Hamas | Balance of Power: Late Edition 07/31/2026
title_cn: 特朗普宣布同意解除哈马斯武装权力平衡：最新版 07/31/2026
summary: "Balance of Power: Late Edition" focuses on the intersection of politics and global business. On today's show, Aaron David Miller, a senior fellow at the Carnegie Endowment for International Peace, warns that a new US attack on Iran could trigger a "major and drastic" expansion of the conflict. Laura Galante, a former director of the Cyber Threat Intelligence Integration Center, warns that Iran could retaliate against new US strikes with cyberattacks on American infrastructure, citing "good precedent" and encouraging operators to strengthen basic defenses as the risk grows. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Trump Appeals Ruling Against His IRS Audit Immunity Deal
title_cn: 特朗普对美国国税局审计豁免协议的裁决提出上诉
summary: President Donald Trump is appealing a court order barring him from attempting to use a sweeping audit-immunity settlement that resolved his $10 billion lawsuit against the Internal Revenue Service.

title: Galante Warns Iran Could Target US Infrastructure
title_cn: 加兰特警告伊朗可能针对美国基础设施
summary: Laura Galante, a former director of the Cyber Threat Intelligence Integration Center, warns that Iran could retaliate against new US strikes with cyberattacks on American infrastructure, citing "good precedent" and encouraging operators to strengthen basic defenses as the risk grows. Her comments come after reports that US and state officials believe Iranian hackers were likely behind attacks on more than 30 municipal water systems in Minnesota. At a Cabinet meeting Friday, President Trump rejected that explanation and blamed Minnesota's government for the attacks, without providing evidence. Galante speaks with Joe Mathieu and Kailey Leinz on the late edition of Bloomberg's "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Miller Warns of 'Drastic Expansion' of Iran War
title_cn: 米勒警告伊朗战争“急剧扩大”
summary: Aaron David Miller, a senior fellow at the Carnegie Endowment for International Peace, warns that a new US attack on Iran could trigger a "major and drastic" expansion of the conflict. His comments come amid reports that President Donald Trump has ordered a fresh round of strikes that could begin as soon as this weekend, as the US and Israel reportedly consider targeting Iranian energy infrastructure. Miller says a limited bombing campaign is unlikely to change Tehran's calculations, while renewed escalation would make progress toward a Gaza ceasefire even less likely. He speaks with Joe Mathieu and Kailey Leinz on the late edition of Bloomberg's "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Trump Orders Iran Attack as Soon as This Weekend, WSJ Says
title_cn: 《华尔街日报》称，特朗普最快本周末下令袭击伊朗
summary: President Donald Trump has ordered the US military to carry out a new attack on Iran as soon as this weekend, the Wall Street Journal reported Friday.

title: AI Hedge Fund Collapses as Earnings Hit Tech Giants | Bloomberg Businessweek 7/31/2026
title_cn: 科技巨头盈利受挫，人工智能对冲基金倒闭彭博商业周刊 2026 年 7 月 31 日
summary: Hedge Fund 'Situational Awareness' is working to salvage the situation after a massive AI selloff. Bloomberg's Hedge Fund Reporter Hema Parmar dives into what's going on and what to know about Leopold Aschenbrenner, 24-year-old investor behind the losing AI fund. Plus, Bloomberg's Ed Ludlow breaks down the week's most impactful tech earnings reports, as Apple sees shares dive to end the week. Then, VEON CEO Kaan Terzioglu discusses how the company's telecom networks is helping keep Ukraine connected despite years of war with Russia. Finally, Bloomberg 'Business of Sports' Podcast Co-Host Vanessa Perdomo-Maglione and Randall Williams explain the ramifications of UEFA's vote to boycott FIFA in protest of its selloff. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Microsoft’s US Taxes Drop, Revenue Jumps After Trump Cuts
title_cn: 特朗普削减开支后，微软美国税收下降，收入猛增
summary: Microsoft Corp. is the latest company to report a sharp drop in its current federal taxes despite growing US revenue, following the enactment of President Donald Trump’s sweeping tax law last year.
